context: Adds a lock_version column and handles concurrent edits on inventory items.
explanation: The migration adds the lock_version integer column (default 0, not null) that ActiveRecord's optimistic locking automatically picks up on InventoryItem. The controller now rescues ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError — raised when a concurrent update has already bumped lock_version — and returns a clear 409 Conflict instead of letting the exception bubble up as a 500 or silently overwriting a concurrent change. This is exactly how Rails expects optimistic locking to be wired up end to end.
